data.rationale: The proposal follows the same arXiv → Semantic Scholar → note procedure in the right order, but it omits the category parameter and the Subject tick, never mentions closing the tab or the "New note" click, and wrongly says author comes from Semantic Scholar, so an automation built from it would pick the wrong subject filter and be vague on some steps.
